correctness.rationale: For all integers t>=1, the exact cubic translation yields one real root u in (1/2,2/3) and two conjugate roots. Exact partial fractions show c_n>=R^{-n}(A-2|B|). The positive factorization of s^2v^2-R^2d^2 in u, with f(u)>f(1/2)=1/8, proves A>2|B| uniformly. All steps hold at k=0, n=0 and arbitrary n; finite rational recurrence checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof. See RESULT.md and verify.py.

value.rationale: Resolves the complete first nontrivial odd denominator slice of a named matrix-exponential coefficient conjecture, for both unbounded numerator k and unbounded Taylor order n. Establishes a strict all-index pole-residue certificate instead of eventual positivity or bounded computations. In combination with published degree-five failure this identifies the cubic-to-quintic boundary as the first odd degree at which sign failure may occur; does not overclaim full odd-degree positivity.
